set system host-name CGN.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set security nat source pool nat1 addres.template: set security nat source pool [parameter1] address [parameter2]/[parameter3] to [parameter4]/[parameter5]
set security nat source pool nat1 addres.command: set security nat source pool nat1 address 10.34.161.101/24 to 10.34.161.105/24
set security nat source pool nat1 addres.explanation: 配置NAT源地址池的地址范围。

parameters.name: start-mask
parameters.explanation: 起始地址的子网掩码位数。

parameters.name: end-mask
parameters.explanation: 结束地址的子网掩码位数。

set security nat source rule-set source-.command: set security nat source rule-set source-nat-rules
set security nat source rule-set source-.explanation: This command configures a source NAT rule set in Junos, defining a collection of rules for translating source IP addresses in traffic matching specified criteria.

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the NAT rule book.

rule rule1.explanation: This command configures a source NAT rule within a specified rule-set, defining how traffic matching the rule is translated before leaving the network.

then source-nat pool nat1.explanation: Configures the address pool that you want to use for the NAT conversion.

parameters.name: pool-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the address pool used for the source NAT conversion.

set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.command: set firewall family inet filter acl-2001
set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term allow-traffic.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

then accept.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 security.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 security zones trust

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
